description: AI extracts a reusable content template from a pasted post text. Synchronous (seconds) — no polling needed. Pass save=true to also persist the template to the brand's library. Returns the extracted template object; if saved, includes the new template id.

postText.description: The full text of the post to deconstruct into a reusable template (min 10 chars).

save.description: When true, the extracted template is saved to the brand's template library.

name: template_extract
